Provalus is actively hiring entry-level Healthcare Insurance Customer Support Representatives to support claims processing, member inquiries, and customer service activities for health insurance products. THE JOB

Responsibilities include:


  • Learn and apply claims processing procedures, healthcare terminology, and company systems through structured, on-the-job training.

  • Research claims status, benefits, eligibility, and coverage details using available resources, CRM, and internal claims processing systems.

  • Handle and resolve member and provider inquiries related to claims processing, billing questions, coverage, and general customer service issues.

  • Provide members and providers with clear, accurate information regarding plan benefits and claims status.

  • Process claims-related forms and other member/provider requests accurately and within required timeframes.

  • Identify and escalate priority or complex issues to senior team members or management as needed.

  • Route inbound calls to the appropriate internal resources, including claims, billing, or clinical teams.

  • Follow up on more complicated member calls as needed, with support from senior team members.

  • Complete accurate call notes and claims documentation, updating records in the CRM and claims processing systems.

  • Gather and record relevant details from member/provider interactions, including comments, inquiries, complaints, and actions taken.

  • Maintain strict confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII) in accordance with HIPAA and applicable regulations — full training provided.

  • Communicate and coordinate with internal departments (e.g., claims, billing, provider relations) as needed.

  • Ask questions and seek guidance from trainers, mentors, and team leads as you build your skills.

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Must have an HS Diploma or GED.

  • No prior healthcare, insurance, or claims experience required — comprehensive training provided.

  • Willingness to learn healthcare terminology, basic medical billing/coding concepts, and insurance claims processes.

  • Ability to work onsite at the Provalus office. No remote positions are available currently.

  • Excellent communication skills, including verbal and written communication.

  • Ability to work well with others in a team environment.

  • Good computer skills and comfort learning new software/systems; ability to multi-task.

  • Willingness to learn and follow HIPAA and confidentiality requirements when handling sensitive information.

  • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to double-check work for accuracy.

  • Ability to stay calm, professional, and patient in stressful or fast-paced situations.

  • Coachable and open to feedback, with a strong desire to grow within the healthcare insurance field.

  • Paid, structured on-the-job training — no experience necessary to get started.

  • Clear path for career growth and advancement into more senior or leadership roles.

  • Supportive team environment with ongoing coaching and mentorship.

job.description:
Customer Service Analyst
Hours: Monday – Friday, 7:00 AM – 6:30 PM CST
Department: Customer Support / Operations
Position Overview
The Customer Service Analyst is responsible for providing frontline support and resolving customer concerns and inquiries received through phone, email, chat, and other online platforms. This role serves as the first point of contact for users needing assistance with system access, application navigation, technical troubleshooting, and product feature support.
The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically proficient, and able to communicate clearly while delivering a positive support experience.

Key Responsibilities
Customer Support & Issue Resolution

  • Respond promptly to customer inquiries through phone, email, chat, and online support platforms
  • Provide professional, courteous, and efficient customer service at all times
  • Assist users with account access issues and login troubleshooting
  • Guide customers through password resets, authentication issues, and account recovery processes

Application & System Support

  • Support customers with app navigation and updated system interfaces
  • Walk users through new menu layouts, feature locations, and functionality updates
  • Troubleshoot basic technical issues including:
  • Error messages
  • Application crashes
  • Slow loading performance
  • Connectivity concerns
  • Recommend solutions such as system restarts, reinstalls, or internet connectivity checks
  • Verify device compatibility with current system requirements

Escalation Management

  • Escalate unresolved or complex technical issues to Level 2 Support when necessary
  • Document detailed notes regarding customer interactions, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions attempted
  • Ensure timely follow-up and communication with customers on escalated cases

Customer Education & Feature Support

  • Educate users on new platform features and enhancements
  • Demonstrate upgraded tools such as:
  • Enhanced conversation/chat functions
  • AI-driven responses
  • Self-service support options
  • Promote use of FAQs, knowledge bases, and chatbot tools to improve customer self-service experience

Service Communication & Feedback

  • Communicate service interruptions or downtime updates clearly and professionally
  • Provide estimated timelines for restoration of services when available
  • Collect and document customer feedback regarding user experience, upgrades, and support interactions
  • Share recurring issues or user concerns with leadership to support continuous improvement efforts

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Previous customer service, technical support, or help desk experience preferred
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to troubleshoot basic technical issues effectively
  • Comfortable working in multiple systems and support platforms simultaneously
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and customer support software preferred

Preferred Skills

  • Experience supporting mobile applications or software platforms
  • Knowledge of customer relationship management (CRM) systems
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and escalation procedures
  • Strong multitasking and time management skills
  • Ability to adapt quickly to system changes and new technologies

Core Competencies

  • Customer Focus
  • Communication
  • Technical Aptitude
  • Problem Solving
  • Team Collaboration
  • Adaptability
  • Attention to Detail

job.description:
Provalus is seeking a Help Desk / Service Desk Analyst to serve as the first point of contact for end users experiencing technical issues, providing timely, friendly, and effective IT support. You will troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity issues, guide users through solutions step by step, and document every interaction accurately in the ticketing system.

This is a great starting point for someone who enjoys solving problems and helping people: you will work under regular guidance from senior teammates and leadership as you build your technical troubleshooting skills, learn the client's systems and tools, and grow your IT support career.

All positions are full-time with set schedules, professional training and development, and opportunities for career advancement. Take the next step in your career today!

WHY WORK FOR PROVALUS

Provalus is a 100% U.S.-based company on a mission to create meaningful technology and customer experience careers in rural American communities where opportunities have traditionally been limited. Instead of sending work overseas, Provalus invests in small towns—building local Centers of Excellence (including locations such as North Wilkesboro, NC and Tahlequah, OK) and developing talent from within those communities.

Key Reasons to Join Provalus

  1. Real Career Path, Not Just a Job Provalus hires people and actively develops them. Many team members start with customer support and advance into higher-level technical, quality, or leadership positions. On-the-job training is provided, and the company emphasizes skills growth and internal promotion.
  2. Paid Training with No Experience Barrier Formal tech experience is not required for many entry-level roles. Provalus invests in training so you can learn systems, processes, and customer support skills while getting paid. This makes it an accessible starting point for people looking to build a long-term career in technology services.
  3. Full-Time Stability and Benefits Positions are full-time with set schedules. Employees receive professional development support, opportunities for advancement, and a benefits package that includes COMPANY PAID HEALTHCARE.
  4. Purpose-Driven Work in Your Community Provalus is built around revitalizing rural economies. Team members work for a company that deliberately chooses small-town locations and hires locally. For many employees, this means building a career close to home while contributing to the economic growth of their own community.
  5. Supportive, Team-Oriented Environment. The culture emphasizes collaboration, mentoring newer team members, and continuous improvement. Employees are encouraged to share frontline insights that improve processes and customer experience.
  6. Growing Company with Expanding Opportunities Provalus continues to open and expand sites across the U.S., creating more roles and advancement paths. As the company grows, high performers have increased opportunities to take on greater responsibility, move into specialized technical work, or step into leadership.

Who Thrives at Provalus

People who succeed here typically value clear structure, customer interaction, steady full-time work, and the chance to grow skills over time. Strong communication, reliability, a calm approach under pressure, and a willingness to learn are more important than prior technical

job.title: SOC Analyst
job.description:
SOC Tier 1 Security Analyst

Job Type: Full Time
Location: Onsite/Brewton, AL

Position Overview

This role is responsible for monitoring security events within a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platform, performing initial alert analysis and triage, managing event aggregation and correlation, and escalating potentially significant security events to the appropriate security operations teams.

The position operates within a 24 hours per day, 7 days per week, 365 days per year (24x7) security operations environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor security events and alerts within the customer's Google SecOps SIEM platform.
  • Perform Tier 1 alert and event triage, assessing alerts for relevance, severity, and potential security impact.
  • Review and manage aggregated security events to identify related activity and reduce duplicate or unnecessary tickets.
  • Perform initial event correlation to identify potentially related alerts and security activity.
  • Create and document security tickets based on identified events and established operating procedures.
  • Escalate security events requiring additional investigation or response to appropriate Tier 2/Tier 3 analysts or security teams.
  • Monitor and triage alerts generated by the customer's Web Application Firewall (WAF) and ingested into the SIEM.
  • Maintain accurate and timely ticket documentation, including relevant alert information, analysis, actions taken, and escalation details.
  • Help prevent unnecessary ticket sprawl by appropriately aggregating and correlating related events before creating individual tickets where practical.
  • Follow established security operations procedures, escalation criteria, and service-level requirements.
  • Support operational reporting and workload metrics related to event monitoring, triage, ticket creation, and escalation.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), cybersecurity operations, or security monitoring environment.
  • Understanding of common cybersecurity events, alerts, threats, and indicators of compromise.
  • Experience with SIEM platforms and security alert investigation.
  • Ability to analyze and prioritize security alerts based on severity and potential impact.
  • Familiarity with event correlation, aggregation, and escalation processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
  • Ability to follow defined procedures while exercising sound judgment when evaluating security alerts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 operational environment, including assigned shifts, nights, weekends, and holidays as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Google SecOps (formerly Chronicle).
  • Experience monitoring or triaging Web Application Firewall (WAF) alerts.
  • Familiarity with common SIEM concepts including log ingestion, normalization, correlation rules, alerting, and incident/ticket management.
  • Security certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, GIAC, or comparable credentials.
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and SOC processes.

Work Environment

This is a 24x7 Security Operations Center role supporting continuous security monitoring. Candidates must be comfortable working an assigned shift schedule that may include overnight shifts, weekends, and holidays.
Job Type: Full Time 3rd Shift
Hours: Saturday - Wednesday 12AM - 9AM
Location: Onsite

What You’ll Do

As a Tier 1 SOC Analyst, you will serve as a first line of defense by monitoring security activity, identifying potentially significant events, documenting findings, and ensuring appropriate events are escalated for further investigation. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, disciplined ticket management, and the ability to distinguish meaningful security activity from routine or duplicate alerts.
